title: Bosses Reimagined
description: This is release of Bosses Reimagined. It is release but  ,if you have any bugs you can message me.
body:
In release you can find five bosses and two mini boss.

First Boss
-----------------------------------------------------------
Wildfire is stronger and bigger version of blaze.
It can be found near the blazes.
It has 1 special attack.
Special attack-he generates cloud of fire that will damage you.

Second boss
-----------------------------------------------------------
Ancient Evoker is bigger version of evoker.
It can be found in the mansions and during the raids.
It has some differences with normal evoker, first he can 
use his spells without cooldown, second, he has 300 hp and
he has 1 special attack.
Special attack-he cast explosion spell that damages and make you
blindness for 10 seconds.

Third boss
------------------------------------------------------------
Elder shulker is bigger version of shulker.
It can be found in the end near the endermans
He have one special attack-end explosion that will hurt you 
The artifact that is dropped
from boss will be used to summon guardian of end finale boss of
this datapack.

Forth boss
-------------------------------------------------------------
Void phantom is bigger and stronger version of regular phantom.
It can be found in the End and Near the endermans.
He creates poisonous cloud that will damages you.

Fifth boss
-------------------------------------------------------------
Giant Cave Spider is bigger and stronger version of normal 
cave spider. He doesn't have any special attacks. He
can be found in the overworld.

First Mini boss
-------------------------------------------------------------
Ilusioner is pillager that can teleports create his clones 
and make you blindness.
Can be found in mansions and raids.

Second Mini boss
-------------------------------------------------------------
Ghost is mob that doesn't have any special attacks but he has
100 hp.
Can be found in the overworld.

Important
-----------------------------------------------------------
Please before starting your adventure reload your Minecraft.
Also, guardian of end is in development.
